data.comment:
# Comfy LTX-2- Audio to Video

Upload an audio file and a starting image frame. Generate a video synchronized to the audio using the LTX-2 model. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs a COMFY_API_KEY.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/video_ltx_2_audio_to_video.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
